capabilities: Detect RTL characters in rendered content blocks
Apply per-block, per-note, and global direction settings
Set note direction through YAML frontmatter
Mirror the Outline sidebar tree for RTL scripts
Cycle direction from the status bar indicator
extras: Per-note direction is saved in the plugin's data.json rather than the note; YAML frontmatter takes priority over saved selections and the global default.
intentEvidence: Any-RTL provides flexible right-to-left (RTL) and left-to-right (LTR) direction handling for Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian's native direction detection leaves mixed RTL/LTR notes, per-note direction, and the Outline sidebar misaligned for right-to-left scripts.

relations.evidence: builds on ideas and implementation patterns from these open-source Obsidian plugins
builds on ideas and implementation patterns from these open-source Obsidian plugins

summary: Direction-handling plugin that detects RTL text and applies per-block, per-note RTL/LTR direction, with an RTL-aware Outline sidebar.
